description: This Java source file defines the ProtocolFactory class, which provides static helper methods for creating and manipulating Protocol Adapter related objects such as TopicPaths, Payloads, Headers, and Adaptables within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for constructing TopicPaths from strings or various IDs, creating Payloads from JSON, and generating Headers with specific content types.

classes.name: ProtocolFactory
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for creating and manipulating protocol-specific objects in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: newAdaptableBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new AdaptableBuilder for a given TopicPath or Adaptable or with an overwrite TopicPath.

methods.name: setExtra
methods.description: Returns a new Adaptable with the 'extra' JSON object field added to its payload.

methods.name: newTopicPath
methods.description: Constructs a new TopicPath from a string path, parsing its components.

methods.name: newTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new TopicPathBuilder from various identifiers such as ThingId, NamespacedEntityId, or PolicyId.

methods.name: newPayload
methods.description: Creates a new Payload from a JSON string or JsonObject.

methods.name: newPayloadBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new PayloadBuilder optionally with a JSON Pointer path.

methods.name: newHeadersWithDittoContentType
methods.description: Creates DittoHeaders with a specified headers map, setting the content type to Ditto protocol.

methods.name: newHeaders
methods.description: Creates DittoHeaders from a collection of header entries or a JsonObject.

methods.name: wrapAsJsonifiableAdaptable
methods.description: Wraps an Adaptable into a JsonifiableAdaptable to provide JSON representation.

methods.name: jsonifiableAdaptableFromJson
methods.description: Creates a JsonifiableAdaptable from a JSON representation.
